verdict.rationale: Runway's docs mention a Playground for testing, copy-paste cURL and SDK examples you can run, and a probed OpenAPI 3.1 spec, which together cover the 'runnable examples' half of the story. However, nothing shows the API reference itself is interactive, such as an in-page 'try it' console tied to the endpoint reference. The Playground's scope is only mentioned in one line. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-reference request console, details on what the Playground covers, independent hands-on corroboration.
